lock_effect: On both boards, red means blocked and nothing else; staleness becomes a quiet muted row with a gold tick and the age printed, so Dave's eye goes to real blockers first.

mutations.change: Ground drops to --panel-2 and text to --muted (the offline treatment); remove any red or conflict styling from stale-but-unblocked rows.
Print the age (e.g. 'stale 3d') followed by a gold tick in --accent; gold marks 'needs a look', never a field or a fill.
Conflict tokens stay exclusive to this state: --status-conflict-text for the blocker line, keyline if the keyline variant is also locked.
Blocked wins: a row that is both stale and blocked renders as blocked, with the stale age still printed.

summary: Rows stale past 48h stop shouting red: they drop to the muted offline treatment with a small gold STALE tick, reserving the conflict red for genuinely blocked rows only.
